## 📋 Checklist

### Before Submitting
- [ ] I have followed the Contributing Guidelines
- [ ] My changes follow the code style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own changes
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings

### For Theory/Research
- [ ] Theoretical framework is clearly explained
- [ ] All mathematical derivations are shown
- [ ] Related work is properly cited
- [ ] Assumptions are clearly stated
- [ ] Potential limitations are discussed

### For Code
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix/feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have added necessary comments and docstrings
- [ ] Code follows PEP 8 style guidelines
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

### For Documentation
- [ ] Documentation is clear and complete
- [ ] Examples are working and tested
- [ ] Grammar and spelling are correct
- [ ] Links are valid
- [ ] Formatting is consistent

### For Experiments
- [ ] Methodology is clearly described
- [ ] Data collection process is documented
- [ ] Results are presented with appropriate visualization
- [ ] Error/uncertainty analysis is included
- [ ] Reproducibility is ensured
